title: Port of Los Angeles Phase 1 geographic data register
coordinate_reference: GeoJSON coordinates are longitude, latitude in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326); the source files do not declare a legacy CRS object.

datasets.source: City of Los Angeles Open Data; linework supplied by Port of Los Angeles
datasets.license: City dataset terms; check dataset page for current terms
limitations: Berth lines are not terminal boundary polygons.
263 records contain 261 distinct berth labels; records are line features and should not be described as 263 unique berths.
Engineering drawing network-path metadata has been removed from the public export.
Terminal IDs are directory-range associations on existing berth lines, not terminal polygons; conflicting source ranges are explicitly withheld from automatic matching.
datasets.terminal_association_method: Numeric label match against the shared, non-disputed ranges in the current Port directory/facility pages; disputed TraPac labels 134–135 are not attached.

limitations: No footprint is Port-verified.
The Port directory lists seven major container terminals; the four community polygons are not a complete terminal inventory.
One polygon has no name attribute; do not infer its operator.

datasets.source: City of Los Angeles GeoHub; Bureau of Engineering, Mapping Division
limitations: Service attributes include raw status/section fields; their definitions are not normalized in this app.
A right-of-way centerline does not certify current public access, open status, or real-time route conditions.
The downloaded area is an extent-based subset; line features intersecting the extent can extend beyond its edge.

datasets.source: City of Los Angeles GeoHub; Bureau of Engineering
limitations: This designated overweight-container route is not the complete road network.
It is not a live route closure or permit advisory.

datasets.source: Port of Los Angeles container directory and individual terminal facility pages
datasets.status: Port-listed terminal records with explicit number-range associations to existing Port-supplied berth-line geometry
limitations: No Port-certified terminal polygon geometry integrated; all seven boundary statuses remain incomplete.
Two Port terminal pages have conflicting berth-number ranges; only their shared ranges are matched automatically.
A berth label matching a range does not establish an independently surveyed spatial relation or terminal boundary.
Facility attributes are as published on Port pages; the pages do not expose a uniform attribute update date.

datasets.source: NOAA Office for Coastal Management Marine Cadastre; U.S. Coast Guard Nationwide AIS
datasets.citation: Martin, Daniel R., Jesse Brass, Matthew Dornback, and Jeremy Fontenault. 2025. Nationwide Automatic Identification System 2024. NOAA Office for Coastal Management.
datasets.status: verified historical AIS sample; not live
limitations: Study extent is a rectangular clip, not a Port-certified or legal harbor boundary.
AIS coverage and message reception are incomplete; a missing observation is not proof a vessel was absent.
No location is interpolated; trajectory lines are broken where timestamp gaps exceed 10 minutes.
The NOAA nationwide daily source is processed locally; only this clipped harbor/time sample is included in the frontend.
Vessel descriptive fields are the first available values within the selected window and may be missing.
datasets.timestamp_semantics: BaseDateTime is the exact source timestamp in UTC seconds. NOAA describes the product as downsampled to the nearest whole minute; playback groups records into minute bins while point details preserve the exact source time.

datasets.source: Port of Los Angeles official historical container statistics
limitations: Monthly throughput is not synchronized to the six-hour AIS sample and is not an AIS-derived rate.
Values are copied from the official Port archive; no interpolation or imputation is performed.

remote_services.name: USGS 3DEP elevation
remote_services.metadata_note: App does not currently surface the selected source raster, acquisition date, resolution, vertical units, or vertical datum. Do not use for engineering/flood analysis until those are checked.

remote_services.name: NOAA BAG bathymetry image service
remote_services.metadata_note: Visualization of available bathymetric survey products; not a guaranteed current navigational chart. Survey dates and vertical datum vary by source.

remote_services.name: NOAA BAG survey coverage
remote_services.metadata_note: Survey coverage footprint is metadata about surveys, not a depth sounding.

validation_scope: GeoJSON parse, feature counts, geometry-coordinate finiteness/ranges, and AOI overlap checks were performed for the bundled snapshots. These are data integrity checks, not a positional survey or Port certification.

terminal_directory_reference.source: Port of Los Angeles container terminal directory
terminal_directory_reference.use: Facility/berth-range reference. Numeric-range matches are attached to existing Port-supplied berth lines; no terminal polygons are inferred.

phase2_operations_analytics.ais_source: Existing local NOAA Marine Cadastre six-hour AIS bundle, 2024-07-15 15:00:00Z to 21:00:00Z
phase2_operations_analytics.synchronization: Dashboard minute selection, hourly bars, selected MMSI, vessel map highlights, and analytics use the same replay state.
activity_methods: Observed-fix counts retain source rows including repeated MMSI/timestamp rows.
Distinct vessels are unique MMSIs in half-open UTC minute or hour bins.
Speed histogram uses non-null source SOG in knots with bins [0,2), [2,5), [5,10), [10,15), and [15,infinity).

spatial_density.method: Count source AIS fixes per 0.005 degree WGS 84 cell in the selected UTC hour; selected MMSI filters the overlay.
spatial_density.interpretation: Report density only; not unique-vessel density, berth occupancy, live activity, or a complete traffic census.

terminal_proximity.method: Assign each source fix at most once to its nearest terminal-associated existing berth-line segment if local equirectangular point-to-segment distance is at most 100 m.
terminal_proximity.interpretation: Observed vessel proximity only. It does not verify berthing, occupancy, arrival/departure, or terminal boundary.

phase2_operations_analytics.csv_export: Calculated AIS time windows, speed bins, hourly activity, proximity counts, density grid cells, and official monthly TEUs; includes units, filters, methods, and source URLs.
phase2_operations_analytics.live_data: None. Historical AIS is labeled historical, not live.
